finalText:
Build's clean now, 0 errors.

Two real bugs were hiding under all that deprecation noise, both from the bundler bump changing shapes underneath your code.

1. `src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler sends `retryCount`. That was crashing the build outright.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` treated a missing backoff flag as invalid and threw. The new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, so I made `undefined` mean disabled.

The remaining warnings are just deprecation noise from the bump, safe to ignore for now.
